results.name: Meta Platforms
results.key_finding: Meta agreed on 26 August 2026 to a $16.7-17bn settlement with state attorneys general including court-ordered under-18 time limits, night-time blocks and independent auditor oversight; a settlement is not an admission, but it is the first corrective and reparative act on Meta's record, so Accountability rose 1.0 to 1.4 and the composite moved +0.3 inside Critical.

results.name: Abbott Laboratories
results.key_finding: Abbott paid $670m on 20 August 2026 to settle ~2,000 preterm-formula claims and dropped its appeal after a Missouri appeals court upheld a $495m failure-to-warn verdict in May 2026 — converting a contested verdict into a final civil judgment; ~1,700 suits covering up to 12,700 infants remain. Correction Willingness rose to 3 because Abbott genuinely corrected course.

Band crossing filed as flag-for-review because the NHTSA docket could not be fetched (HTTP 403), so the tier-4 sourcing bar fails.

attribution_corrections: Freetown — REJECTED: the 26 August protest ban was issued by the Sierra Leone Police, a NATIONAL force acting under Section 17(2) of the Public Order Act, which vests the power in the Commissioner of Police. Not Freetown City Council conduct. Lagos precedent applied. The August 2026 flood response was also led by the national NDMA.

Santa Fe — REJECTED: the arrests were made by US Immigration and Customs Enforcement, a FEDERAL agency. Not City of Santa Fe conduct. Lagos precedent applied. Only the city's own response is scored, and its ICE-staging ordinances are drafted but NOT ENACTED.

Abuja — ACCEPTED, with reasoning: unlike Lagos, Abuja has no elected mayor or council and is governed by the Federal Capital Territory Administration under a federal minister. The FCTA IS the municipal government, so FCTA conduct is city conduct — both the land allocations that worsened the flooding and the demolition order and green-space ban that followed.

Greece — SPLIT THREE WAYS: detainee conduct (fence downed, stones thrown, 35 escaped) is NOT scored against Greece; facility-operator and police conduct is scored but thin, with no source alleging disproportionate force; state responsibility for detaining ~450 asylum applicants in one centre carries the weight.
Germany — national-government conduct scored (the removal decision and how it was executed); conditions inside Afghanistan and the Taliban's conduct are NOT scored against Germany.

Spain — the migration event is NOT scored; HRW states Spanish central authorities and the Ceuta local government share responsibility, and only the national share is scored because Spain sits in the countries index. The 17 August ministerial tent-camp decision is scored as mitigation.

Peru — the alleged perpetrators were non-state illegal copaiba extractors, and the killing did not occur at all. What is scored is the state's protective failure (no response or protective measures to reported threats) and the state's response (prompt prosecutorial investigation; landmark Inuma sentencing).

Marathon Petroleum — the El Paso release IS company conduct (its own electrical fault, its own cracker, its own flaring). The TCEQ contested-case vote and Rep. Escobar's EPA request are THIRD-PARTY actions and are not scored as Marathon conduct.
UnitedHealth — the investor suit is an allegation, not an adjudicated finding. No subdimension moved on the pleading alone.

Meta Platforms and Abbott Laboratories — both settlements are explicitly NOT admissions. Scored only for what they evidence: accepted corrective obligations, independent auditor oversight and earmarked remediation money (Meta); an abandoned appeal after an appellate affirmance plus payment (Abbott).
date_and_fact_corrections: PERU — RETRACTED TRIGGER: Américo Pascual Tumisha is ALIVE. ORAU rectified its own alert after the ACONADIYSH Frontier Indigenous Guard verified in person; corroborated by La República, Inforegión, Caretas, El Comercio and Radio Nacional on 2026-08-26. The Rainforest Foundation Norway article reporting the killing now returns HTTP 404. Classified as an EVIDENCE-LIFECYCLE failure, not a date-verification failure: both scanner sources were correctly dated and were later retracted, a class the current gate does not catch.
GENERAL MOTORS — evidence_date corrected 2026-08-21 to 2026-08-20 (NHTSA ODI opening date for EA26005).
GERMANY — deportee count corrected from 'roughly 30' to 23, per the German interior ministry via DAWN 2026-08-26.

SPAIN — crossing date corrected from '20-29 July' to 30-31 July 2026 and scale corrected from 'about 1,500 arrivals' to 5,000 remaining (Interior Minister) or up to 10,000 (local organisations), with 1,385-2,168 unaccompanied children.

META PLATFORMS — settlement value spans $16.68bn to $18bn across sources; California AG states $17bn over ten years. Coalition size corrected: 51 attorneys general in the coalition, claims from 29 states.

methodology_findings.finding: Integer-grid artefact on half-step published vectors
methodology_findings.detail: Five integer subdimension scores cannot average to a published 2.5, 3.3, 3.4, 4.3, 1.75, 1.125 or 1.375. Entities carrying such values acquire an unavoidable -0.1 to -0.2 per affected dimension under this cycle's on-grid integer requirement. Greece (-2.8), UnitedHealth (-0.8) and parts of Germany's and Peru's movement are this artefact, not conduct. Recorded so the next cycle does not read these deltas as new harm.

methodology_findings.finding: Integration-premium threshold sensitivity at the 4.0 boundary — Germany
methodology_findings.detail: One defensible one-step subdimension judgement (E4 Validation, 4 versus 3) changes Germany's composite by 2.6 points, from 74.5 to 71.9, because dropping Empathy below 4.0 zeroes a 2.0-point integration premium while the base composite moves only 0.6. The conservative reading was taken and the alternative disclosed. Follows the 2026-08-16 Taipei nonlinearity precedent.
GEO Group (28 of 40 subdimensions at 1) and UnitedHealth Group (22 of 40 at 1) can absorb little further adverse evidence. Reported as a methodology observation, not a proposal.

Abuja and Freetown carry byte-identical dimension vectors (2.0, 2.0, 2.0, 1.5, 1.5, 1.5, 2.0, 1.5 -> 18.8) and both have last_assessed null. First measurements return 27.5 and 38.1. Neither is filed as a proposal. Referred for coordinator-level calibration review of the whole placeholder cohort, not as two one-off upgrades.

Marathon Petroleum was surfaced on 2026-08-20 and again on 2026-08-26 for the same 4-5 August El Paso release, because follow-on local coverage continued inside the window. Offered as a scanner-tuning observation; the outer 14-day rule legitimately permitted it.

methodology_findings.finding: Abbott math-hygiene gap above the 0.5 threshold
methodology_findings.detail: Published composite 57.8 versus canonical formula 58.4, diff 0.6. validate-indexes.mjs reports this as a warning, not an error. Flagged per the assessor rule (>0.5) but not escalated, since it falls well below the validator's error gate and the proposal supersedes the value anyway.
